_note: Required-content manifest per CODE-JUNCTION/BRIDGECAD_GAD_ACCEPTANCE_RESOLUTION.md §4. Every row needs stable ID, target view/support, expected primitive/semantic entity, required dimension/label, evidence, implementation status and reviewer verdict. Status vocabulary: PRESENT | PARTIAL | MISSING | NOT_APPLICABLE. Reviewer verdict: PENDING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED.
_wording_note: The reference booklet (CODE-JUNCTION/GENERAL ARRANGEMENT DRAWINGS.pdf, SHA-256 38C224549A50CC72A20AAA01E07B33618789DC4D3881844363BDA199DD44A23D) contains no nine-span sheet (span counts in booklet: 2-5 only). Rows marked BOOKLET_CONVENTION apply to the invariant drawing conventions across all booklet pages. Rows marked NINE_SPAN_GEOMETRY apply to independently verified nine-span geometry and cannot be pixel-matched to a reference sheet.

duplicate_renderer_maintenance_task.description: bridgecad_draw/sheets/* duplicates the root sheetN_*.py modules (contract/plugin base only). The production renderer uses the root modules; the duplicate tree is not a defect but is a maintenance hazard. Retained here as an open task.

combined_suite_stall_evidence.description: The combined pytest stall was diagnosed and corrected (not merely diagnosed). Root cause: scripts/prove_detection.py copied the full tree per mutation (7859 files / 303 MB ~45 s per copy * 19 copies). Fixed by adding _IGNORE_EXT binary list and extra ignore dirs.
